evidence.snippet: The Cloud Developer Bundle provides a free Atlassian cloud development site for building and testing
OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps are created and managed in the developer console

decisions.reason: Developers can get a free Atlassian cloud development site and create OAuth 2.0 (3LO) apps in the developer console at no cost, with rate-limit tiers only affecting high-volume/per-tenant usage, not initial access.

decisions.reason: Jira exposes a large REST API (v3) covering many resources (issues, projects, permissions, plans, policies, tasks, teams, users, webhooks, workflow schemes) plus GraphQL and webhooks, indicating a broad surface.
